description: Pierre Morey's 2015 Bourgogne Aligoté is a dry, medium-bodied white with lively acidity and a clear Meursault-grown mineral character. Citrus, green apple, and subtle almond tones move through a lean, refreshing palate.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2015 Domaine Pierre Morey Bourgogne Aligoté.
sommelierNotes: Serve at 9-11°C as an aperitif or alongside oysters, gougères, freshwater fish, or goat cheese.
